group.name: DL1C
group.description: Single, vertical-component deep-learning P picker. The picker interface name to configure in scautopick's "picker" parameter is "DL1C". The configured model must export seiscomp.picker.numComponents = 1.

parameter.name: model
parameter.description: Path to the ONNX model file. Required, no default: setup() fails if this is empty or the file does not satisfy the seiscomp.picker.* metadata contract.

parameter.name: minConfidence
parameter.description: Minimum model confidence (in [0,1]) for a P pick to be accepted, compared against the model's peak P output value. Among the P-curve peaks that clear this threshold the picker takes the most confident one whose S probability at that same sample stays below 80% of its P value; a peak the model fires on almost as strongly for S is skipped in favour of the next candidate. Only relevant if the model also exports an "S" output.

parameter.name: minLatency
parameter.description: Seconds after the trigger at which the earliest evaluation window ends and its inference runs. It is the soonest a pick can be emitted. Default: same as maxLatency. Disregarded when maxAttempts is 1; use maxLatency in that case.

parameter.name: maxLatency
parameter.description: Seconds after the trigger at which the latest evaluation window ends. Default: half the model window, a window centred on the trigger (best pick quality); lower it to trade quality for a faster pick. Also where the single window sits when maxAttempts resolves to 1.

parameter.name: maxAttempts
parameter.description: Number of evaluation windows, spread evenly from minLatency to maxLatency. If unset the count is computed as ceil((maxLatency - minLatency) / (windowDuration/2)) + 1, where windowDuration is the model's window length in seconds, clamped to [1,20], so it is 1 when minLatency equals maxLatency. Set it explicitly to cap inference cost, or higher to tighten pick times (with strategy = best) or the pick latency (with strategy = fast). 1 = a single window at maxLatency.

parameter.name: strategy
parameter.description: "fast" accepts the first window whose confidence clears minConfidence (lower latency). "best" evaluates every window and keeps the single most confident pick (higher accuracy).

parameter.name: polarityMinConfidence
parameter.description: Minimum confidence (in [0,1]) to set the pick's first-motion polarity, compared against the model's first-motion output at the picked sample. Only relevant if the model also exports seiscomp.picker.polarityLabels; ignored otherwise. Below this, polarity is left unset rather than reported as undecidable.

parameter.name: uncertaintyAtMinConfidence
parameter.description: Time uncertainty to report when the pick's confidence is at minConfidence, the worst accepted case. Together with uncertaintyAtMaxConfidence, linearly maps confidence to a derived time uncertainty for a model that does not export seiscomp.picker.uncertaintyLabels; ignored if it does (a real per-sample value always wins), and has no effect unless uncertaintyAtMaxConfidence is also set. Unset by default: no uncertainty is derived.

parameter.name: uncertaintyAtMaxConfidence
parameter.description: Time uncertainty to report when the pick's confidence is 1, the best possible case. See uncertaintyAtMinConfidence; both must be set together.

group.name: SDL1C
group.description: Single, vertical-component deep-learning S picker. The secondary picker interface name to configure in scautopick's "spicker" parameter is "SDL1C". The configured model must export seiscomp.picker.numComponents = 1.

parameter.name: model
parameter.description: Path to the ONNX model file. Required, no default: setup() fails if this is empty or the file does not satisfy the seiscomp.picker.* metadata contract.

parameter.name: minConfidence
parameter.description: Minimum model confidence (in [0,1]) for an S pick to be accepted, compared directly against the model's peak output value.

parameter.name: minLatency
parameter.description: Seconds after the reference P pick at which the earliest evaluation window ends and its inference runs. It is the soonest a pick can be emitted. Only the part of a window after the P pick is searched for the S. Default: half the model window, the window centred on an S at S-P = 0 s, or maxLatency if that is lower. Disregarded when maxAttempts is 1; use maxLatency in that case.

parameter.name: maxLatency
parameter.description: Seconds after the reference P pick at which the latest evaluation window ends, and so the limit on what the picker can reach. Default: 60 s plus half the model window, the window centred on an S at S-P = 60 s. Also where the single window sits when maxAttempts resolves to 1.

parameter.name: maxAttempts
parameter.description: Number of evaluation windows, spread evenly from minLatency to maxLatency. If unset the count is computed as ceil((maxLatency - minLatency) / (windowDuration/2)) + 1, where windowDuration is the model's window length in seconds, clamped to [1,20], so it is 1 when minLatency equals maxLatency. Set it explicitly to cap inference cost, or higher to tighten pick times (with strategy = best) or the pick latency (with strategy = fast). 1 = a single window at maxLatency.

parameter.name: strategy
parameter.description: "fast" accepts the first window whose confidence clears minConfidence (lower latency). "best" evaluates every window and keeps the single most confident pick (higher accuracy).

parameter.name: uncertaintyAtMinConfidence
parameter.description: Time uncertainty to report when the pick's confidence is at minConfidence, the worst accepted case. Together with uncertaintyAtMaxConfidence, linearly maps confidence to a derived time uncertainty for a model that does not export seiscomp.picker.uncertaintyLabels; ignored if it does (a real per-sample value always wins), and has no effect unless uncertaintyAtMaxConfidence is also set. Unset by default: no uncertainty is derived.

parameter.name: uncertaintyAtMaxConfidence
parameter.description: Time uncertainty to report when the pick's confidence is 1, the best possible case. See uncertaintyAtMinConfidence; both must be set together.
